title: 5-(3-(N-(Carboxymethyl)naphthalene-2-sulfonamido)phenyl)-1-ethyl-1H-pyrrole-2-carboxylic acid as a Keap1–Nrf2 inhibitor for cerebral ischemia/reperfusion injury treatment
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,1052-1059
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06512C, Paper

Nanjia Cairang, Yanran Wu, Shumeng Zhi, Jiaqin Tang, Xin Tie, Dui Zhan, Guangyuan Lu, Ying Shi, Qipeng Zhao
The Keap1 (Kelch-like ECH-Associating Protein 1)–Nrf2 (Nuclear Factor Erythroid 2-Related Factor 2)-ARE (Antioxidant Response Element) signaling pathway plays a crucial role in the oxidative stress response and has been linked to the development and progression of various diseases.
